notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo 0.69.4
notes.content:
Hey y'all, this one's a bit bigger of an update than the last few, and also includes a full rework of the spells system. You should now be able to purchase spells with Lust, and can equip up to 3 of them. With that in mind, spells no longer will automatically be added on a new save in level 1, 3, and 5.

Bug Fixes:


 Replaced some of the old textures for the girls.
 Spell damage no longer displays twice for several spells.
 Dungeon items actually work now.
 Fixed spells not showing the current cooldown and status in the dungeon before/after battles.
 Spells that are designed to last multiple turns now do.
 Regeneration now applies all of the time, not just when the player is below a certain amount.
 Hopefully fixed an issue where tiles would stick when selecting a spell sometimes.


New Features:


 Added the LFL icon when the game is running instead of the default Godot icon.
 Added ability to pass 1 time slot by visiting date locations.
 Added in level to the item hover info popup.
 Completely reworked the spell system and screen.
 Added spell hover info to dungeons and battles.
 Regeneration now shows values when healing the player.
 Added a few more dungeon items to the game.


Changes:


 Set the pause menu to be available while inside of towns and in the dungeon exteriors.
 Changed the calculation for damage from weapons especially. Weapons should not scale to obscene amounts anymore.
 Nerfed Curse damage, as it was still doing obscene damage.
 Shield now carries stacks across turns until they are used to block and enemy’s attack. These will decay at a rate of 10 per turn.
 Disabled the notification that Kurvanog wants you to come to her house tonight until the sex scenes are in the demo.
 Disabled sorting buttons in the Pause Menu temporarily until sorting works correctly.
 Removed several spells from the game until they can be reworked.
 Status effect labels now float up a lot less quickly.
 Made it substantially more clear that the player can drag all the way horizontally and vertically.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo 0.69.3
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:


 Fixed an issue where bleed, reflect, or thorns damage will freeze the game, or play the incorrect animations.
 Tweaked bleed, burn, and poison to only apply for 1 turn, since with a 25% chance that most items give, it was proccing constantly.
 Fixed an issue where sometimes expressions were not showing up in dialogue scenes.
 Fixed the player not ever being able to leave the dungeon.
 Fixed a few spelling issues.
 Fixed the background image for the dungeon repeating too soon.
 Florence no longer pops up as visitable in the demo.
 Fixed spells not showing up in the pause menu unless they are active.


New Features:


 Added upgrade points, which allow your core stats to be leveled up to 20. This should apply retroactively, so it shouldn’t break an existing save file.
 Completely redesigned the pause menu.


Changes:


 Redesigned the Character and Rucksack tabs, and combined them into the Player tab.
 Did a small makeover on the Character Creator screen.
 Slightly increased the size of all of the dungeon markers on the world map.
 The boss monster in the dungeon will no longer move, and will need to be defeated before leaving the dungeon.
 Toned down the damage on curse tiles a bit, both for damage to enemies, as well as damage to the player.
 When starting a new game, player now gets a random weapon from Kurvanog before entering the dungeon.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo 0.69.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:


 Pause menu is a little less wonky now.


New Features:


 Added a falling trap to the dungeon.
 Added spike traps to the dungeon.
 Added some silly damage sound effects to the player.


Changes:


 General balance changes. I might float the idea of reworking the item and experience system overall.
 Increased the base amount of experience to level up, since leveling up was way too fast.
 Can now toggle Fullscreen in the pause menu from anywhere.
 Window no longer looks terrible on 1080 resolution or lower. Screen should dynamically scale to 80% of your monitor’s resolution no matter what size monitor you have.
 Tweaked monster base damage and health slightly so that early battles are a lot less punishing.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Demo 0.69.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:


 Fixed infinite blackscreen when you lose in the tutorial dungeon.
 Disabled saving in the dungeon.
 Spell cooldown correctly resets back to 0 when leaving a dungeon.
 Monsters no longer break exiting the dungeon when you fight them at the end of a dungeon area.
 Dungeon theme in the tutorial now loops properly.
 Removed the second left dungeon items / date items arrow. It shouldn’t have existed to begin with.
 Fixed a crash when equipping the same dungeon/date item in the 6th slot.
 Fixed the back menu button on the world map so that it actually works.
 Fixed the Hide/Show Equipped items toggle in the shop.


Changes:


 Tweaked tile spawn rates slightly so coins aren’t everywhere.
 Increased damage of Curse tiles.
 Girls will now cache their expressions and clothing textures when they are first loaded.
 Monsters will now only be level 1 until the player has completed the dungeon.
 Shops will now generate stamina potions to sell.
 Shops now reset their inventory daily.
 Hopefully addressed some of the overpowered nature of weapons and armor, and tweaked the values of date and dungeon items.

notes.title: Lust For Lucre Pre-Release Demo Available Now
notes.content:
Hey y’all! The demo for Lust For Lucre is now live! And it works great! Kinda. We’re a week out from the October Next Fest, and we finally have the demo ready in a playable state, and we want to get it out to your hands while we work on crushing the last few (hundred) bugs before finishing up work on the remaining damsels and flush out the overarching storyline. Right now, the demo only covers Kurvanog, and we’re still finishing up the dialogue for her main storyline, so there will be a lot of very rough dialogue that will be visible here. We’re mostly using this to get a good basis for where the game is, what’s fun, and what needs to be improved. Expect this demo to have some (a lot of) bugs, and please report them so that we can crush them!

Known bugs:

 General flow of everything is a bit janky.
 Nipples keep popping through clothing when transitioning scenes.
 Balance of items isn’t great, especially with early game date/dungeon items.
 Dungeon is lacking trap variety, and is going to get a lot more stuff.
 Stat points aren’t currently in the game, but need to be added. (These will be tracked by your current and total lust)
 Stats that are displayed in the Ars Uberia are incorrect.
 The current quest items may or may not work at all.
 … and a few hundred other things throughout the game.


Roadmap:

 Improve the UI and overall playability of the game.
 Balance out the items, and add more date/dungeon items to the game.
 Add several more trap types, loot, and other environmental hazards to the dungeons.
 And also consider adding multiple levels, branching paths, etc.
 Add the ability to level up your character properly using stat points, and use them to purchase perks.
 Add in romance scenes with each of the damsels.
 Add in different activities to each of the date locations (These are all planned, and are going to add a ton of things to do that aren’t just doing dates and rummaging through dungeons). Examples of this are: 
 The Booty Bay Casino! Gamble away all of your hard-earned winnings.
 The Peeping Tom! Try to get a glimpse of naked ladies before being kicked out of the Oppai Onsen.
 The BF Hole! Dig your way through the ground and use a claw to pick up shiny treasure with the dwarves!
 And just generally fixing/improving a bunch of other things.


These are all going to be massively improved over the next few weeks, and as we work on these fixes for the game, the demo will continue to be updated.

Thanks for your consideration! Any and all feedback is greatly appreciated!
